deviation: The draft lets the Supplier process personal data at its own discretion, including to "improve its services", instead of only on Arcadia's documented instructions. It also drops the requirement to comply with data protection law and to sign a DPA before processing. This removes Arcadia's control over its data and creates regulatory exposure.
suggested_text: The Supplier shall process personal data only on the Customer's documented instructions and in accordance with applicable data protection law. A Data Processing Agreement must be executed before any personal data is processed.
